version.description: Version is the file's schema version.

task_default_eur.description: TaskDefaultEUR is a task's budget when its intake asks for none.

task_max_eur.description: TaskMaxEUR is the most a task may be given.

day_eur.description: DayEUR caps all tasks together per UTC day; 0 stops all spend.

budget.description: Budget caps spend in EUR per task and per UTC day.

sessions.description: Sessions is how many agent sessions a task gets before it goes to a human with every finding so far (the round cap); a human may grant more.

agent_time.description: AgentTime is the agent's working time across all sessions of a task, such as 20m; waiting on checks or on a reviewer does not count.

supervisor_calls.description: SupervisorCalls is how many supervisor model calls one session may make; the next trip escalates without one.

supervisor_timeout.description: SupervisorTimeout bounds one supervisor or review model call, such as 6m.

stronger_after.description: StrongerAfter is how many returns from the same stage a task takes on its model; the next return takes the stronger rung.

steps.description: Steps caps one agent session's model turns (opencode's agent steps), at least 1: at the cap the harness asks the model to summarise and stop. Absent: DefaultSteps.

nudge_after.description: NudgeAfter is how many identical tool calls in a row (same tool, same input) earn the running session a message to change approach, at least 2. Absent: DefaultNudgeAfter.

nudges.description: Nudges is how many such messages one repetition gets; the next run of the same call trips the supervisor, at least 1. Absent: DefaultNudges.

same_call.description: SameCall is how many identical tool calls in one session, in a row or not, trip the same_call detector, at least 2 and above NudgeAfter: a repetition gets its nudges first. Absent: DefaultSameCall.

limits.description: Limits bound every task's work: sessions, agent time, supervisor calls.

classes.description: Classes are the capability classes a task can hold, by name.

models.description: Models are the aliases the agent may call through the gateway.

tools.description: Tools are the gateway tools the class may call: a paid tool with its per-task caps, a free tool as {}.

max_requests.description: MaxRequests is how many calls of the tool a task may make.

max_eur.description: MaxEUR is how much a task may spend on the tool.

additionalProperties.description: ToolCap caps a paid tool per task; a free tool carries none.

review_model.description: ReviewModel is the alias factoryd's model review calls on the task's account.

supervisor_model.description: SupervisorModel is the alias the session and gate supervisors call on the task's account.

audit_model.description: AuditModel is the alias factoryd's security audit calls on the task's account (ruling 188).

additionalProperties.description: Class is a capability class a task can hold: the model aliases it may call through the gateway and its tools with per-task caps, and the aliases factoryd calls on the task's account, which the agent may not.

eur_per_credit.description: EURPerCredit is what one Firecrawl credit costs.

scrape_credits.description: ScrapeCredits is the most credits one scrape is held at.

search_credits.description: SearchCredits is the most credits one search is held at.

eur_per_second.description: EURPerSecond is the price of a second of predict_time by hardware SKU.

models.description: Models maps each usable model (owner/name) to its hardware SKU.

max_seconds.description: MaxSeconds is how many seconds of its hardware a prediction is held at, whole seconds, at least 10.

max_megapixels.description: MaxMegapixels is how many megapixels a call priced per megapixel is held at.

prices.description: Prices are the tool prices no provider API reports.

name.description: Name is the class's name; auto is allowed on class normal only.

outcome.description: Outcome: forbidden fails the task, requires_approval waits for a human, auto merges without one where the merge rule allows it.

migration.description: Migration marks paths whose change needs the human's schema review.

items.description: RiskClass is a named class and what it means for the pull request.

classes.description: Classes are the risk classes, most severe first.

class.description: Class is the risk class of a matching path.

items.description: RiskRule: Paths are globs anchored at the repository root, "/" separated; "**" matches any number of whole segments, other segments match as path.Match.

rules.description: Rules map path globs to a class; a path takes the first match.

default.description: Default is the class of a path no rule matches.

risk.description: Risk classifies a pull request by the paths it changes.

monthly_eur.description: MonthlyEUR caps a calendar month (UTC), reservations and accrued cost together, in net EUR.

server_types.description: ServerTypes are the Hetzner server types a task may commission.

max_count.description: MaxCount is how many servers may run at once.

volume_max_gb.description: VolumeMaxGB is the largest volume per server: 0 for none, else at least 10.

envelope_default.description: EnvelopeDefault is the resource envelope of a project whose file sets none, and the most any project file's envelope may set.

approvers.description: Approvers are the Forgejo users who may authorize spend in the console (ruling 128): approve a resource request or a merge, promote a resource. Empty: nobody.

bounds.description: Bounds are how many seconds one run of an activity may take before it raises a gate_bound alert, per activity name and a default for the rest; absent keys take DefaultBounds.

supervisor.description: Supervisor holds the session supervisor's progress detectors: how many seconds without the progress each names before it trips; absent keys take DefaultDetectors (ruling 161: no_write only).

cpu.description: CPU bounds CPU requests and limits, such as 2 or 500m.

memory.description: Memory bounds memory requests and limits, such as 4Gi.

storage.description: Storage bounds the persistent volume claims' requests, such as 10Gi.

quota.description: Quota is each of the project's namespaces' ResourceQuota.

monthly_eur.description: MonthlyEUR is the fixed monthly line for standing resources.

server_types.description: ServerTypes are the server types a standing resource may have.

max_count.description: MaxCount is how many standing servers may exist at once.

standing.description: Standing bounds the project's standing resources.

project_default.description: ProjectDefault is what a project file leaves out takes, and the most its quota and standing may set; absent: DefaultProject.

link_hosts.description: LinkHosts are the hosts, their subdomains with them, that links in agent-written text factoryd posts on Forgejo may point at; the Forgejo host and the project's environment hosts always may. Any other link is defanged (hxxps://evil[.]example).

title: factory/policy
description: Document is policy.yaml, schema version 1: budgets, limits, capability classes, prices, risk rules, the default envelope, approvers, activity bounds and the supervisor's detectors.
